_about: Number painted on the in-game map for each internal area number, per quest map id (index = internal area, value = number shown on the map, 0 = base camp). Collected in the game by mh3u-quest-studio (Matt Wood, MIT licence, see THIRD_PARTY.md) on the Wii U version; the 3DS version has the same areas (its spawn points and start tables are identical). Maps not listed use the game's own numbers.
